title: GPU procurement timeline + risk heatmap (working)
content:
Purpose
- Single-page working sheet to align orders, expected lead-times, and regional risk for the next 6 quarters.
- Focus: SKU mix adjustments, order phasing, and contingency routing (spot vs reserved).

Scope & assumptions
- Time horizon: Q1 2026 -> Q2 2027 (8 quarters, primary planning for next 6).
- Demand baseline derived from current host + dedicated forecasts (internal forecast v3.1).
- Target utilization: 78% steady-state (we currently run ~72%). Goal to hit 80% for Dedicated pools but average platform target 78%.
- Budget constraint: commit to no more than $32M in GPU capex for H1 2026 (negotiation w/finance).
- Currency: USD. Lead-time estimates are supplier-provided and include customs/transport buffer.

SKU matrix (summary - working numbers)
| SKU | Perf tier | Typical use | LT (weeks) | MOQ | Notes |
|-----|----------:|------------|----------:|----:|------|
| NVIDIA H100 94GB | top | large-model LLMs, low-latency chat (prod-critical) | 12-18 | 8/unit | Preferred for Hosted high-tier; supplier A quoting 14 wks average.
| NVIDIA A100 80GB | high | training/serve older models, caching nodes | 8-12 | 16/unit | Still best cost/perf for many workloads; pipeline runs through supplier B.
| NVIDIA L40S | mid | inference-heavy image/vision, multi-model serving | 20-28 | 4/unit | Longest lead time currently due to allocation; consider substitution or rental for Q1 2026.
| NVIDIA A10G | low-mid | small embeddings, infra experiments | 4-6 | 32/unit | Fast turn; use for burst capacity and labs.
| Generic 4xA100-1U (blended) | mixed | on-prem legacy appliances | 10-14 | 2 racks | Special shipments, customs slower (APAC).

Regional lead-time adjustments
- US-West / US-East: baseline LT (supplier A/B) ±1 week.
- EU-West: +2 to +4 weeks (customs, VAT paperwork).
- APAC (SG/Tokyo): +3 to +6 weeks; L40S suppliers prioritizing local hyperscalers -> longer queues.

Procurement timeline (high level)
- Nov 2025: lock target SKU mix (this doc) -> finalize PO templates.
- Dec 2025: initial POs for H100 x48 (reserve tranche 1), A100 x160 (tranche 1), A10G x320 (on-call orders) -> target ship windows Feb-Apr 2026.
- Jan 2026: conditional POs for L40S x32 (backfill only if lead-time confirmed <24wks) -> ship Apr-Jun 2026 if confirmed.
- Mar 2026: review capacity utilization; trigger tranche 2 for H100/A100 if utilization >80% or backlog >7 days.
- Jun 2026: finalize Q3 reorder calendar and review vendor SLAs.

Order phasing rationale (short bullets)
- Prioritize H100 early to scale hosted high-tier product and meet SLOs.
- Use A100 as workhorse for Dedicated; higher MOQ but better immediate availability.
- Keep L40S as optional/backfill due to volatile LT and pricing; consider short-term rental or cloud spot for Q1.
- A10G for burst and experimentation (low LT) to avoid over-allocating expensive SKUs.

Risk heatmap (working grid) - likelihood vs impact (color = textual)
- High impact / High likelihood: L40S long lead-time & pricing surge -> RED (mitigate w/ rental + alternative SKUs).
- High impact / Medium likelihood: H100 allocation shortfall from supplier A -> ORANGE (build second-source and partial fallback to A100).
- Medium impact / High likelihood: Customs delays EU/APAC for mixed racks -> ORANGE.
- Low impact / Medium likelihood: Minor SKU price movement (A10G) -> YELLOW.

Quick ascii heatmap (rows: impact high->low, cols: likelihood high->low)
Impact
 High  | RED  | ORANGE | ORANGE
 Med   | ORANGE | YELLOW | GREEN
 Low   | YELLOW | GREEN  | GREEN
Likelihood -> High | Mid | Low
(Notes: RED entries = L40S allocation; ORANGE primary = H100 supplier risk + region customs)

Fleet-level recommended order schedule (working numbers)
- US total (target + buffer): H100 x24 (Dec PO), A100 x80 (Dec PO), A10G x160 (Dec PO).
- EU total: H100 x12 (staggered Jan), A100 x40 (Jan), A10G x80 (Jan).
- APAC total: A100 x40 (Dec/Jan), A10G x80 (Dec), L40S x16 (conditional Apr).
- Global optional rental pool: L40S equivalent capacity 32 units reserved for Q1-Q2 2026 (vendor rental agreement draft with Supplier C).

Inventory & utilization quick calc (current snapshot)
- Current inventory (est): H100=32, A100=240, L40S=8, A10G=512.
- Nominal usable capacity today -> combined TFLOPs normalized = utility metric; using redwood-util v2.2 calculator -> current utilization ~72%.
- If we receive tranche 1 as proposed, projected utilization drops to ~68% immediately (buffer), then rises to 82% by May 2026 under baseline demand growth.

Contingency playbook (short)
- If H100 shipments delayed >4 weeks: immediately re-route 50% of burst workload to on-demand cloud H100 instances and shift canaries to A100 with model quantization guidance.
- If L40S LT >24 weeks: activate rental pool + pause any L40S-based feature launches til Q3.
- If EU shipments delayed: pre-authorize air-freight for critical racks (finance signoff needed - see linked ticket).

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- [ ] Confirm finance upper bound for total committed spend through Jun 2026 (expected $32M but need final sign-off). -> @Marcus
- [ ] Get final lead-time confirmation from Supplier C for L40S (call scheduled 2025-11-18). -> @Sofia
- [ ] Legal to review rental agreement template (Supplier C) and add penalty clauses for no-delivery. -> @Yuki
- [ ] Evaluate cost model for partial quantization fallback on A100 -> action: run model-perf sims (perf-team ticket).

Related links / quick refs
- CONFLUENCE:INFRA-GPU-LIFECYCLE-2025 (detailed SKU sheets)
- JIRA:GPU-PIPE-1123 (po creation pipeline)
- GH:pr/infra/procurement-metrics (scripts to calc utilization and cost)

Notes / freeform (scratch)
- We should test an alternative: small H100 rental for 3 months while waiting for large H100 fulfillment; rental economics seem bad but may be cheaper than revenue loss from SLO breaches.
- Consider building an "urgent lane" PO with Supplier B for guaranteed 8-week partial delivery on A100 (pay premium).
- Keep this doc as working: convert to formal procurement playbook once vendor replies come in (expected end-Jan 2026).

Revision log (short)
- 2025-11-10 created (initial draft).
- 2025-11-18 vendor LT updates inserted (notes).
- 2025-12-05 updated tranche quantities and regional split after finance sync.

-- end working sheet --
